'''Verkul Seimbo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Filordus]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Seimbo worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] and in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he became the leader of a small consortium of Filordi within the Cartel, and met with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alina Impeveri]] on [[Varna Biqua]], to discuss entering a criminal partnership with her. After ironing out the details of their plan, Impeveri and Seimbo formed a criminal group that Impeveri dubbed "[[the Syndicate]]," and they established a base of operations inside the [[Ishkik caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Using his position within the Cartel, Seimbo supplied the [[Rock Rogues]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that he and Impeveri had hired, with details of Cartel shipping movements in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], allowing the Rogues to attack Cartel starships and steal their cargo.<ref name="Holes" />
